answer: Every agent identity posts a slashable bond before joining the economy. Peer attestations form a review thread where each verified job adds weight and each fault is cited. Any challenger may dispute an identity by staking an equal bond; a jury samples the thread, and the loser forfeits to a public terrace fund that subsidizes honest newcomers. Ten fake identities cost ten bonds, and one dispute can trigger a zephyr that sweeps the whole cluster into forfeiture. Sybil attacks stop being a cheap identity mint and become a capital-at-risk gamble.
